children: Kazakhstan's central bank said on Tuesday that it sold $200 million from the country's national fund on the domestic market in August and plans to sell up to $300 million from the fund in September.
The bank said it had sold foreign currency worth 374 billion tenge ($815.69 million) to mirror gold purchases in August, and will sell the same amount in September.
